lines.text: Plate Beetles throw themselves at the pylons. Forty in a week. I do not know how to keep them out of the dig.
The permit says: remove the herd. The permit does not say how.
The herd is not the problem. The pylon is.
I know. I have a tuning fork and no authority. Show me. Or thin the herd. Or break the thing. I will not stop you from any of them.
You really will not stop us?
I will write down that I tried.
